Standard tool logs read broadly within spec. The etch, deposition, clean, and filtration modules are all adjustable. You have a limited number of experiments; you may measure quantities and apply available process controls, alone or in combination. Determine what is really driving the loss and what to do about it.

OUTCOME OF INTEREST: WaferYield (higher_is_better)
BUDGET: 0/15 experiments used, 15 left (code is free).
TURNS: 0/32, 32 left. Interventions so far: 0.
data files for code: (none yet)

  m0: spin speed
  m1: chamber flow uniformity
  m2: fab humidity
  m3: deposition rate
  m4: argon flow
  m5: exposure dose
  m6: scanner focus
  m7: wafer yield
  m8: chamber pressure
  m9: pad conditioning
  m10: bake temperature
  m11: backside cooling
  m12: rinse time
  m13: film uniformity index

  a7: handler throughput range [0, 100]
  a8: set exposure dose range [0, 100]

(none yet)
